base_version_id.title: Base Version Id
base_version_id.description: Current published version the draft replaces; null for an empty week. Stale → 409.

outlet_id.title: Outlet Id
outlet_id.description: Set for managers and staff; null for owners.

coverage_ratio.title: Coverage Ratio
coverage_ratio.description: sum(min(assigned, preferred) × minutes) / sum(preferred × minutes). null when there is no demand. Overstaffing never raises it.

shifts.title: Shifts

open_minute.title: Open Minute

close_minute.title: Close Minute
close_minute.description: Minutes from outlet-local midnight; values above 1440 continue past midnight

solver_status.title: Solver Status
solver_status.description: Set once solving ends. UNKNOWN means no solution within the time limit; it does not prove infeasibility.

poll_after_ms.title: Poll After Ms
poll_after_ms.description: Suggested polling delay while queued/running; null when terminal.

schedule_id.title: Schedule Id

id.title: Id

logical_shift_id.title: Logical Shift Id
logical_shift_id.description: Stable identity across versions; key diffs on it.

max_assignable.title: Max Assignable
max_assignable.description: Upper bound of eligible staff for this interval.

minimum_required.title: Minimum Required
minimum_required.description: Hard: a roster below this is infeasible.

message.title: Message
message.description: Deterministic text built from facts; safe to show.

facts.title: Facts
facts.description: Structured evidence, e.g. rest_minutes and required_rest_minutes.
